messages.author: e7a71d967e60bb41
messages.subject: Bug in my ggplot2?
parts:
|Dear All,
Sorry for the many questions, but I am not yet very proficient with ggplot2.
I suspect there may be a bug in installed ggplot2; consider for example the code taken from
|http://tinyurl.com/yesdmog

|library("ggplot2")
df.actual <- data.frame(x=1:100, y=(1:100)*2)
df.approx <- data.frame(x=1:150, y=(1:150)*2 + 5 + rnorm(150, mean=3))
p <- ggplot() +
geom_point(aes(x, y, colour="Actual"), data=df.actual) +
geom_line(aes(x, y, colour="Approximate"), data=df.approx) +
scale_colour_manual(name="Type",
values=c("Actual"="black", "Approximate"="black"))
library("grid")
grob <- ggplotGrob(p)
tmp <- grid.ls(getGrob(grob, "key.segments", grep=TRUE, global=TRUE))$name
grob <- removeGrob(grob, tmp[1]) # remove first line segment in legend key
tmp <- grid.ls(getGrob(grob, "key.points", grep=TRUE, global=TRUE))$name
grob <- removeGrob(grob, tmp[2]) # remove second point in legend key
grid.draw(grob)
|
when I try to run this code on my machine (debian testing, ggplot2 installed from cran2deb repository) this
is what I get

Error: attempt to apply non-function

Does anybody else have the same problem?
Cheers

Lorenzo

If you specify the first data.frame inside the ggplot command it works

regards,
